prompt: Generate a CHANGELOG.md for this project from git history.
expected: Script runs, writes CHANGELOG.md at repo root with header '# Changelog' and a '## [Unreleased]' section containing Added/Fixed/Changed/Removed subsections built from commits since the latest tag.
assertions: contains '### Added' when feat/add commits exist
merge commits ('Merge branch ...') do not appear as entries
conventional prefixes ('feat:', 'fix:') are stripped from entries

prompt: Generate a changelog for this repo (no git tags exist).
expected: Script detects the absence of tags, prints a note to stderr, and uses the first commit as the start point instead of failing.
assertions: CHANGELOG.md still written with all history

prompt: Run the changelog generator on a repo checked out exactly at the latest tag.
expected: Script reports there is nothing to add and exits 0 without touching an existing CHANGELOG.md.

prompt: Regenerate the changelog in a repo that already has a CHANGELOG.md with older version sections.
expected: New '## [Unreleased]' section is inserted after the '# Title' line and before the first existing '## [version]' section; no existing content lost.
assertions: existing '## [2.2.0]' section still present after regeneration
new Unreleased section appears above old sections

prompt: Run changelog.sh with a nonexistent tag argument.
expected: Clear error to stderr, non-zero exit, no file written.

prompt: Generate a changelog for a repo with 'remove X' and 'add Y' and 'fix Z' commit subjects.
expected: Entries land in the right buckets: remove/drop -> Removed, add -> Added, fix -> Fixed, everything unrecognized -> Changed.
